label: Claim Rule
description: The rule for one claim kind, as a config document: how many holders may hold it on one case at once (max_holders), which other kinds it cannot be held together with (excludes, checked in both directions), and how long an active claim's lease runs (lease_minutes). Read by the KB gateway at every acquire. A kind with no rule document gets the defaults: 1 holder, no exclusions, 60 minutes.
